principle: AI统一基于Pi：pi-ai为统一模型调用层；pi-agent-core为Agent执行与运行状态管理层；应用持久化长期记忆和业务状态并通过受控工具读写。

modelBoundary.providerProtocols: Pi built-in provider or registered Pi-compatible adapter only
modelBoundary.discoveryHttp: GET /models allowed inside catalog adapter; is not inference
modelBoundary.unsupportedProvider: unsupported_provider; no fallback raw HTTP path
modelBoundary.providerDefault: deepseek is default, not a universal hard-coded identity
modelBoundary.modelRoleVsMode: extraction/aggregation select model configuration; direct/agent select execution behavior, independently
modelBoundary.authentication: adapter-declared required credential or no-auth; do not fake anonymous keys

direct.execution: pi-ai Models.complete/completeSimple or stream/streamSimple; application bounded retry/repair wrapper
direct.structuredSubmit: single submit_result schema function may constrain response but has no DB side effect and is not an Agent
direct.commit: caller shared command service commits validated output

agent.restore: application canonical session projection into Pi Agent state
agent.businessWrites: executing registered AgentTool.execute calls shared command service and returns durable commit receipt
agent.finalSubmit: AgentTaskSummarySchema includes commitIds; does not repeat business mutations

sharedValidation: reference/quote/fact coverage rules applicable to command
same domain command service for direct callers and Agent write tools

sharedErrors.retryOwner: one application retry policy; Agent loop is not a second provider retry layer
sharedErrors.contextRecovery: one additional compaction recovery only for persistent Agent sessions
sharedErrors.businessConflict: CONFLICT tool result is a domain conflict to re-read, not a provider network failure
sharedErrors.backoffCancellation: AbortSignal ends delay before next request

memory.writeTool: commit_story_changes (includes memory_update; empty asset ops permit memory-only commit)
memory.runtimeInstanceScope: bookId + profile; each book has independent Pi Agent state and tools
memory.restore: recreate Pi runtime from the original logical session and canonical messages
memory.windowSwitch: view selection changes subscriptions; events retain original bookId/sessionId/runId
memory.windowUnmount: persisted history survives; cancellation is an explicit task operation
memory.compactionStorage: append summary and projection boundary; retain original messages, tool results and chapter text

futurePlay.windowScope: one persistent conversation window per book
futurePlay.contextScope: book-owned play session with its own role and tool contract
futurePlay.mechanism: shared session persistence, restoration and compaction
futurePlay.schemaDelivery: play integration defines storage upgrade and backup validation before use

memory.commitAnnotationProjection: buffer app commit annotations until matching Pi toolResult batch or explicit interruption placeholders; never interleave before unresolved toolResults

writePolicy.scopeBinding: bookId/runId/sessionId/profile/phase bound by application, not model parameters
writePolicy.revisionBinding: from latest actual tool read-set; same validator as direct mode
writePolicy.repeatSameKeySamePayload: return original durable receipt without new mutation
writePolicy.finalResponseFailureAfterWrite: preserve committed state; report partial/failed with applied commits
writePolicy.businessSuccess: durable commit receipt, never assistant text or agent_end alone
writePolicy.resumeRunIdentity: interruption recovery reuses runId/operationKey with new lease owner; explicit recheck starts new runId but same P3 sessionId
idempotencyCheckOrder: return original same-payload receipt if already applied
only new commands validate current records/read-set then commit
writePolicy.commandAtomicity: all groups/operations in one payload and its idempotency ledger commit together; prior separate commands remain applied on later failure
writePolicy.finalizerPiTermination: valid sole finalizer returns terminate hint or finishTurn end; do not trigger another generation solely to replay mutations
writePolicy.durableIntent: pipelineRuns.commandIntents before any business side effect

probe.direct: Pi direct text request; provider error/abort fails even if transport is 2xx
probe.agent: two isolated suites (asset/story), maxSteps=3, maxTokens=1024, timeoutMs=30000 per suite; exact fixtures and prompts in 05 AI-15
probe.discovery: catalog adapter GET is allowed, cannot substitute for generation validation

packageBoundary.engineReuse: fixed Pi packages and public hooks; native model/tool loop and message/event protocol
packageBoundary.probeOverrides: single-turn finish and short output belong to connection probes
packageBoundary.migrationSpecification: ../../02-架构与技术规格.md#ar-12-pi接入coding包取舍与迁移顺序

requestBudget.contextRecovery: one persistent-Agent compaction recovery within remaining parent budget; summary direct call has its own accounted budget
